system: NAL READ Owner Privacy Review — security gate contract

existingCode.verifiedSubject: per-request Auth user check; x-nal-read-verified header sent with service_role secret

gates.gateway: verify_jwt true; authenticated POST; no GET private dataset
gates.roleCheck: Fresh authenticated user via existing Supabase Auth + current nal_private.admins owner membership; never user metadata or client role
gates.trustedRpcPrincipal: p_owner_id obtained exclusively from validated bearer and Auth admin, not client data
gates.responseHandling: Counts + derived copy counts only; no participant text; fail closed on malformed/unavailable

requiredHumanReview: Security approval for exact p_owner_id authenticated RPC adapter. Previous GitHub write for privileged auth was blocked; do not work around via alternate writer or a new privileged database alias.
Approved privacy notice version and controller/contact, storage/backup/retention schedule.
Owner role assigned only via documented governance, not seeded by this task.
Release-specific server env feature flag managed separately after authorization.
Separate operational erasure policy and customer presale QA; static client gate never replaces server enforcement.
frontendInterlock: nal/data/read-privacy-review.release.json is read-only public state; intentionally false, not a security principal or Supabase authorization artifact.
